sections.description:
Plugin for configuring 5 Ways chat widget, case management, and survey generator scripts.

Third-party service usage

This plugin uses third-party services from 5 ways… By providing the chat widget, form, or survey identifier, data is sent to the script located at:
https://chat.5ways.pl/assets/scripts/widget.js, which causes a widget to appear on the selected page, enabling communication with the client.

The 5 Ways service is located at: https://5ways.pl

All legal information and terms of service for 5 Ways can be found at:
https://support.5ways.pl/pl/prywatnosc-i-ochrona

Service terms and conditions:
https://support.5ways.pl/pl/-regulamin-platformy-5-ways

Service privacy policy:
https://support.5ways.pl/pl/-polityka-prywatnosci
